usedFor: Speak AI analyzes media, and “Media Analyzed” can write results into Google Docs with “Add or Replace Text In Tab”.

bestTemplate.name: “Media Analyzed” in Speak AI, then “Add or Replace Text In Tab” in Google Docs
bestTemplate.why: Once media is analyzed in Speak AI, the Google Docs tab gets the insights as text.

watchOut: “New Magic Prompts Response” in Speak AI is polling, so the doc is updated after a short delay.
